draft_en.body:
Hello,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Industrial PoE Switch" on 25 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the ONV and Utepo PoE switches you list, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; budget unmanaged 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit - STC-028GP - $25.1. Injectors and extenders we do not carry; EAC stays on your side.

One question: which band sells more in your shop - managed, or the unmanaged under 30 dollars?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
